_comment: pay_per_container_nm: a ship is paid capacity x leg distance (nm) x this rate when it finishes unloading; tuned so a Scooter 10 earns about $2,000 per minute of sailing. fuel_price: dollars per fuel unit, the same at every port (fuel is about 40% of a leg's pay). Breakdowns: every breakdown_interval_s seconds there's a breakdown_chance that one random ship at sea (not a Mammoth) loses breakdown_hit of its maintenance (0.5 = 50 points). initial_view_width_deg: how many degrees of longitude the map shows across when it opens, centered on the home port.
